$description: Per-action_type templates for composing Zuora Workflow tasks. Each entry contains description, hooks, a fully-formed template with sentinel slots, required_params, required_at_import, param_enums, boolean_string_params, and (for Tier-1 tasks) data_contract. Distilled from Rails models at ~/Workspace/workflow/rails/app/models/tasks/*.rb. Sentinel tokens: <<TASK_ID>>, <<UPSTREAM_TASK_ID_OR_NULL>>, <<TOP>>, <<LEFT>>, <<REQUIRED: ...>>. The linter fails on any unreplaced <<...>> token.

$data_contract_schema.$description: Per-task contract describing what the task adds to Data.* for downstream tasks (writes), what Data.X.Y references it consumes from upstream (reads), and how predictable that output is at design time. The linter walks the task graph topologically using these contracts to validate Liquid {{ Data.X.Y }} references (rules E170/W171/W172/W173/W174). For non-Tier-1 tasks without a contract, the linter falls back to $default_data_contract.
$data_contract_schema.predictability: One of: 'deterministic' (scope and field shape both fully known: Query, Create, Update, CustomObject::Query, amendments), 'semi-deterministic' (scope known, field shape partial or large/standardized: Export, Billing::BillRun, Payment::PaymentRun, GraphQuery, Logic::Liquid, Approval, Reporting::*, file-handling tasks), 'opaque' (scope known but field shape unknowable until runtime: Callout, AsynchronousCallout, Logic::Lambda, Script::JavaScript, Logic::JSONTransform, Logic::XMLTransform, Logic::CSVTranslator, Logic::ResponseFormatter, Execute::WorkflowTask, Mediation::SendEvents), 'scoping' (no positive writes; routes execution and/or rebinds existing scopes: If, Logic::Case, Iterate, Logic::Merge, Approval, Delete, CustomObject::Delete), 'none' (side-effect-only or non-data tasks: Email, Notifications::SMS, Notifications::Kafka, Delay, UI::Page, UI::Stop, Upload::*, UsageMediation::*, File::FileOperations file-only modes).

writes.fields: comma-separated field names, or from_param:<paramPath>, or OPAQUE, or LIQUID_SCOPE
writes.notes: optional human note

$data_contract_schema.opaque: true if downstream cannot statically know writes[].fields (Callout, Lambda, JS, JSONTransform, XMLTransform, AsyncCallout). The linter emits W172 for downstream Data.<placement>.<field> references unless the opaque task carries a parameters._opaque_trusted='true' or parameters._expected_response_schema={...} sentinel.
$data_contract_schema.opaque_prompt_required: true if the build skill must prompt the user (Step 3e) before composing downstream tasks that reference this task's scope. Mirrors opaque=true for Callout, AsynchronousCallout, Logic::Lambda, Logic::Script::JavaScript, Execute::WorkflowTask, Logic::JSONTransform, Logic::XMLTransform, Logic::CSVTranslator, Logic::ResponseFormatter, Mediation::SendEvents.
$data_contract_schema.rebinds: object key whose Array binding becomes a single Hash inside the For-Each branch (Iterate only). Inside that branch downstream tasks read Data.<rebound>.<Field> for the current row. Outside the branch the original Array binding (or Merge result) returns.
$data_contract_schema.routing_only: true for tasks that only branch (If, Logic::Case, Approval, Delay) — no writes, but reads still apply via parameters.if_clause / case_clause. Used together with predictability='scoping' or 'none'.
$data_contract_schema.fields_partial_known: true when the writes scope is known but the per-row keys are extracted from a free-form param (e.g. GraphQuery selection set, Logic::Liquid assigns). Linter downgrades W171 to a notice.

$sentinel_keys_in_parameters._opaque_trusted: Set to 'true' (string) on Callout/Async/Lambda/JS/etc. to suppress W172 across all downstream references. Rails ignores unknown parameter keys, so this has zero runtime impact.
$sentinel_keys_in_parameters._expected_response_schema: JSON object documenting the expected response shape (e.g. { 'Invoice': { 'Id': 'string', 'Number': 'string' } }). When set, the linter performs field-level checks on Data.<scope>.<field> references for that opaque scope as if it were deterministic.

$default_data_contract.$description: Fallback contract for any action_type not present in this catalog (or for Tier-1 entries without a data_contract block). Treated as opaque: writes nothing the linter can validate, downstream Data.<TaskAction>.* references emit W172. Composer should add an explicit data_contract or _data_contract annotation when known.

$configuration_contract_schema.$description: Per-task contract describing how each `parameters.*` field is sourced in the Zuora Workflow Rails UI, what the controller permits, and what the model validates. Distilled from `app/views/tasks/partials/_<task>.html.erb` (and shared partials), the per-task `case` branch in `app/controllers/tasks_controller.rb`, and the model at `app/models/tasks/<task>.rb`. The composer/build skill consults this contract to (a) only emit fields that survive the controller permit, (b) prompt for fields whose `source` is `describe-call` or `user-input`, and (c) skip fields whose `visible_when` predicate evaluates false against sibling parameters. Linter rules W178 (UI-only-leak) and W177 (undeclared-describe-field) reference these contracts.

field_schema.$field: Dotted path under the task envelope. Most common is `parameters.<name>`; for top-level columns use `<columnName>` (e.g. `object`, `object_id`, `task_id`).
field_schema.purpose: One-line explanation of what this field controls at runtime.
field_schema.source: How the UI populates the value. One of: `user-input` (free-form text/number), `dropdown-static` (hard-coded options inline in the partial), `dropdown-static-from-enums` (options pulled from a Rails constant), `dropdown-from-parent-task` (options derived from the upstream task's `data_structure` or `object_structure` -- e.g. Iterate.object), `describe-call` (options come from a live Zuora describe API call -- e.g. Export/Query/Create/Update parameters.fields), `derive-from-workflow-parameters` (auto-derived from `workflow.parameters.fields`), `callout-response-field` (set at runtime, not user-configurable), `computed` (auto-set by the model; never user-supplied), `code-editor` (CodeMirror text area such as Liquid/JS/SQL), `repeated-row` (UI-driven repeating row form -- e.g. Email recipients, Callout headers), `boolean-checkbox` (rendered as checkbox; persisted as `"true"`/`"false"` strings -- see `boolean_string_params`).
field_schema.options_source: When `source` is dropdown-* or describe-call: short pointer to where the UI gets its options (e.g. `Rails enum Task::CALL_TYPES`, `parent_task.data_structure['Files']`, `describe_helper(object: <object>)`). Omit when irrelevant.
field_schema.required_when: Liquid-ish predicate against sibling parameters that makes this field required (e.g. `parameters.body_type == 'raw'` for Callout.parameters.raw_body). When omitted, the field is either always required (see template `<<REQUIRED>>` markers) or always optional.
field_schema.visible_when: Liquid-ish predicate against sibling parameters that makes this field visible in the UI. When omitted, the field is always visible. The composer should drop fields whose predicate is false (otherwise they can confuse the runtime).
field_schema.controller_permit: How the field is permitted in `tasks_controller.rb`. Common values: `parameters.<name>` (single permitted key), `parameters.<name>: []` (array form), `parameters.<name>_attributes` (Rails nested attributes), `parameters: any-hash` (no per-key strong-params check -- the catch-all branch at L801-802 of tasks_controller.rb). Use exactly the symbol the controller writes.
field_schema.model_validation: Short summary of the model-side validation that runs when persisting through the form (NOT during `import_workflow`, which uses `validate: false`). Cite the model file + line range when nontrivial.
field_schema.default: Default value the React/ERB UI seeds when the field is left blank. Match the literal type Rails will persist (string `"true"` for booleans, integer for chunk_size, etc.).
field_schema.task_process_use: Optional. Mention if `task_process` reads or rewrites this field (e.g. Iterate's chunk_size becomes the For-Each batch).
field_schema.notes: Any extra constraints not captured above (cross-field rules, gotchas, deprecated keys).

$configuration_contract_schema.$design_intent: These contracts are the truth source for: (a) the `zuora-workflow-build` skill's per-task UX (which fields to ask the user for vs. infer); (b) the linter's W177/W178 rules; (c) the composer's drop-list of UI-only fields that must NOT appear in import JSON. They are NOT a runtime schema -- task_process semantics live in `data_contract` (above).

Callout.description: Make an HTTP callout to an external system.

writes.notes: Parsed JSON / SOAP-XML / text response of the external endpoint. Shape is not statically knowable. When include_response_code is true or omitted, response fields live under ResponseBody; direct Data.<payload>.<field> paths require include_response_code = "false".

Top-level `headers_attributes`, `form_datas_attributes`, and `datas_attributes` ride on common_params. Files (parameters.files) are coerced from a hash to an array (L647-649); cert.p12_file is read into bytea (L643-645).

Export.description: Export a Zuora object via SOAP export (bulk CSV).

writes.notes: Export streams CSV results to file storage; downstream Iterate(object=<file_holder_name>) processes the rows. The selected fields parameters.fields[<object>][] become the CSV headers and per-row keys when iterated. Inside that Iterate body, Data.<object>.<Field> is field-level resolvable from parameters.fields.
Export also stores a small reference object at Data.Export[self.object] (see Tasks::Export#task_process self.new_data['Export'][self.object]).

Selected aggregations (Min/Max/Count/Sum/Average) wrap the column. parameters.fields shape is {<Object>: {<FieldName>: "true" | "Min" | "Max" | "Count" | "Sum" | "Average"}}.

Notifications::SMS.description: Send an SMS notification via Twilio. message and numbers are Liquid-parsed at save time and again at runtime.

numbers: <<REQUIRED: array of E.164 phone number strings (Liquid OK)>>

data_contract.$notes: Pure side-effect (sends SMS); writes nothing to Data.*.

configuration_contract.$controller_branch: fall-through `else` (tasks_controller.rb L800-802) -- accepts `parameters` as an OPAQUE hash. Strong params allows nested parameters.sms.{numbers, message} via the same loose permit.
configuration_contract.$model_validation: before_validation :cast (L2 + L18-20) strips blanks from sms.numbers. task_setup_validation (L4-12) requires both sms.message and sms.numbers; when present, BOTH fields are template_parsed in strict+validate mode against fake_payload so Liquid syntax errors fail save.
configuration_contract.$task_process_use: task_process (L22-48) instantiates Twilio::REST::Client with credentials from Rails.application.secrets.twilio, then iterates self.numbers (each entry template_parsed at runtime) and sends client.messages.create(from: secrets.twilio.number, to: number, body: self.message). Each send is logged as an ApiCall record. Twilio errors (especially code 21408, 'permission to send to that destination') are surfaced as WorkflowError. Then iterate_tasks(linkage_type: 'Success').

fields.purpose: SMS body (max 1600 chars per Twilio). Liquid OK.
fields.model_validation: Required non-blank (sms.rb L5); template_parsed at save with strict+validate to catch Liquid syntax errors.
